videos.t: Retro Gaming Console Restoration! — Video Sport 3
videos.desc:
Join us in restoring this 1991 Electronica VideoSport 3 (ВидеоСпорт-3). This was the Atari of the Soviet Union! Let's see if we can get this piece of history up and running again!

Download a hi-res scan of the schematics:

videos.t: Scientific calculator restoration! Will her display shine again?
videos.desc:
Join me in restoring this beautiful 1980 Electronika B3-18А (Электроника Б3-18А)— the first handheld scientific calculator in the USSR! This unit came to us non-functional and missing its non-standard power adapter. Can we restore it? A vacuum fluorescent tube display has never looked so good!

Download the schematics:
https://bit.ly/B3-18A
